subject: adding an annotation with absolute position

messages.author: f1d814afb2326c3e
messages.subject: adding an annotation with absolute position
parts:
Hi All,

 

I’d like to add an annotation based on the graph’s positioning, rather than the data. For example, I’d like to add an annotation in the lower half of the graph. I see I can use viewports, but wondered if there was a way to do this just with the annotation parameters.

 

ggplot2 is great! And I’m sure I haven’t grokked the graphics grammar just yet. L

 

thanx

steve

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: adding an annotation with absolute position
parts:
If you want it in the bottom corner you can use Inf...

tst2<-data.frame(x=rnorm(1000),y=rnorm(1000)) 

ggplot(tst2,aes(x,y))+geom_point()+geom_text(aes(-Inf,-Inf),label="Dude, where's my car?",colour="red", vjust=0, hjust=0)
